rachats.citation: IQVIA Holdings Inc. acquired Linguamatics Limited in January, 2019.
IQVIA Holdings Inc. acquired Pharmaspectra Group Limited from Inflexion Enterprise Fund IV, managed by Inflexion Private Equity Partners LLP in July 2022.
IQVIA Holdings Inc. (NYSE:IQV) acquired Lasso Marketing in third quarter of 2022.
Whiz got acquired by IQVIA on May 01, 2025.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
